procedure.method: Independent review in this fresh session, without spawn, fork, resume or peer-review inspection. Read the pinned packet, literal case, rules, rubric, compact method, addendum and adapter. Verified the declared input pins and PNG header dimensions, and read all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following unlisted embedded producer paths. The packet has no source assets or protected-layout manifests: zero source opens were required or claimed, and both receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Actually opened and visually inspected all exact poster files with tools.view_image, detail original, emitting each returned image in this order: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M2 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M3 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M4 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M5 native/usage720/thumbnail320. All fifteen successful displays preceded the first copy-reading/transcription stage, mandatory judgment and image or set score. The untouched first copy readings were taken from the native displays after that complete viewing pass. No omitted copy was inferred from supplied text and no ambiguity-triggered revisit was needed. Use and thumbnail assessment employed the exact pinned downsampled assets, without creating or editing images. Viewing receipts attest to the actual visually inspected displays, not helper exits, filename assumptions or byte checks; no runtime session ID or serialized tool-event ID is invented.
